{{Quote|We've finished combing the ship, Generals. Zee's nowhere to be found.|[[Cody/Legends|Cody]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Lockdown (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.47|Lockdown (comic story)}}</ref>}}
The '''''Tempestuous''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ''Tempestuous'' made a foray into [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-held [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and returned heading for [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] carrying various captured [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], who were imprisoned in cells aboard the vessel. During the voyage, the renowned [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Arlain Zee]] escaped from his cell and [[Riot aboard the Tempestuous|freed]] several other bounty hunters. The bounty hunters were quickly recaptured by Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and amid the chaos, Zee escaped by downloading his consciousness into the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R5-Q3]].
